messages:
noah: Heads up, created PR to update model-catalog entries for stella-13b and stella-13b-q6. Want to add explicit "effective context" note for q6 and small SDK snippet updates. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4999

emily: nice. can you include p50/p95/p99 in bench table and hardware column? we had confusion last week when someone compared two cards with different hardware.

omar: Also double-check the tokenizer build notes. The quantized q6 build needs a special tokenizer flag for chunked inputs. Add CLI note.

noah: Current PR bench sample (placeholder): ```bash
# bench (local) commit: f0e1d2
# A10G, batch=2, seq=4096
python bench.py --model stella-13b-q6 --seq 4096 --batch 2
# out: 6.1 tok/s, p50 48ms, p95 210ms
```

emily: Please include exact command + commit sha in the card and a short note about env (CUDA 12, pytorch 2.x).

omar: Pushed a small patch about tokenizer flag and a one-liner in the migration section: "If you upgrade from pre-q6 clients, add `tokenizer.chunked = true` for long sequences."

ci-bot: build/docs: #4999 — linkcheck failed on /model-catalog/stella-13b-q6.html#tokenizer (404)

noah: Fixed anchor and pushed. Also added a short SDK snippet in Python and JS showing response_mode usage.

ci-bot: build/docs: #4999 — linkcheck passed

emily: Reviewed, left 2 very small wording nits (rephrase "supports q6" -> "q6 quantized variant")

omar: Merged after nits. Will copy migration guide template into repo root under /docs/model-card-migration-template.md for reuse.
